abilities.effect: The bones spill from the vault and into the adjacent corridor, dealing 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage to each creature within 10 feet of the door (DC 20 basic Reflex save). The area becomes difficult terrain.
abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.trigger: A creature opens the door to the vault

hazard.description: This bone-filled vault disgorges its contents the moment the vault door slides open.
hazard.disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) or Stealth (trained) to carefully open the vault door without disturbing the bones
hazard.name: Bursting Bone Vault

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
